name: citation-guard
description: Agents obtain references only from authoritative records (lcv resolve) and cannot finish while a changed bibliography fails lcv check --strict; approvals stay human-only.

interface.shortDescription: Verified references only, checked before the agent finishes
interface.longDescription: Agents obtain references with lcv resolve from Crossref, PubMed, arXiv, DBLP and OpenReview instead of writing them from memory. A Stop hook blocks the end of a turn while changed bibliographies fail lcv check --strict, and a PreToolUse hook denies edits of the human approval list. It verifies existence and metadata, not whether a paper supports a claim.
defaultPrompt: Add verified references for these claims to refs.bib
Check my bibliography with citation-guard and fix what fails
